jp: ・・・ここまで来れば平気だな
en: ...We should be fine now that we've come this far.

jp: 危ないところだったぜ？
en: Honestly, you two. That was a close one, you know?

jp: でも、ありがとうエクサル
また助けられちゃったね
en: Sorry... But thank you, Exal. You saved us again.
Don't mention it. Don't worry about it.

jp: 僧兵に目をつけられたのは
ちょっとやっかいだな
en: More importantly, getting on a monk soldier's radar is a bit of a problem.

jp: ここのところ悪魔による被害が
深刻で、教団のやつらも
厳戒態勢中なんだよな
en: Demon attacks have been bad lately, so the Church guys are on high alert.
Demon attacks?

jp: ああ、最近市街地やその周辺で
頻繁に悪魔が目撃されていて
何人も殺されているんだ
en: Yeah. Demons keep turning up in and around town lately. Quite a few people are dead.

jp: しかもまた、その食欲の旺盛な
ことといったらなくて、日に日に
死体の数が増えていやがる
en: And what an appetite it's got. The body count goes up by the day.

jp: 食欲・・・と言うことは
en: Appetite... Which means...

jp: 犯人は＜渇き＞に狂った悪魔に
en: Yeah, you got it. The culprit has to be a demon mad with the Thirst.
The Thirst?
A sickness only demons get.

jp: この病気になっちまうと
理性がぶっとんで、人を襲って
その血を飲むようになるんだ
en: Catch it, and reason goes out the window. You attack people and drink their blood.
One of the reasons demons are so loathed.

jp: それで今この街には・・・
en: And so, right now, this town has...

jp: 悪魔討伐のスペシャリストが
en: Word is the Church has sent a demon-slaying specialist here.

jp: 教団の上層幹部か・・・
渇きに狂った悪魔の討伐となると
よほどの手練れだろうな
en: Church high command... Hunting a demon mad with the Thirst would take a real expert.
Could it be... that six-winged angel!?

jp: 噂じゃ派遣されてきたのは
天使じゃないって話だ
en: Sorry to disappoint. Rumor says the one they sent isn't an angel.

jp: まさか、例の男のことか？
en: Not an angel... Could it be that man?

jp: ああ、十審将お抱えの強剣士様が
この街に来ているらしい・・・
en: Yeah. Seems the Ten Tribunal Generals' pet master swordsman is in town...

jp: ま、お手合わせは勘弁だな
en: I'm curious, but I'll pass on crossing swords with him.
Oh? Now that's an interesting story.
Who's there!?

jp: 血の臭いが濃い街だとは
やっぱりこの街にいるみたいね
en: I thought this town reeked of blood. So it really is here after all.
...Yeah.
D-..demons!?

jp: お前達が街を襲っている
en: Damn!! Are you the Thirst-mad demons attacking the town!?
How rude. Who are you calling mad?
These two...
You... from back then.

jp: まさか、生きていたなんてね
en: I can't believe you're alive.

jp: こいつら知り合いなのか？
en: ...Hey. You know these two?

jp: 前にキボートス島で会ったんだ
en: ...Yeah. We met on Kibotos Island before.

jp: 傷ではなかったはずだ
en: ...You. No one survives a wound like that.

jp: それに、この気配・・・
en: And this presence...

jp: 嫌な臭いが混じってるわね
en: Yes. There's a nasty smell mixed into the human scent.
What are you?
I don't really know myself.
You don't know what you are?

jp: 俺たちを馬鹿にしているのか？
en: Are you making fools of us?

jp: 本当にわからないんだ
en: ...But I really don't know.

jp: 見つけたわよ不審人物！
en: Found you, you suspicious lot!
Yikes!! You're that monk soldier from before!?

jp: このあたしステイエンに
にらまれたのが運の尽きよ！
en: Your luck ran out the moment I, Stayen, set my sights on you!

jp: 大人しく職務質問に答えなさい！
en: You suspicious lot there! Answer my questions quietly!

jp: 一緒に教会まで来てもらうわよ！
en: You two in the back are coming to the church with us too!
...Who is this woman?
Black-wings!?
Isn't it obvious?
...A-a-ah
Demons!?
Eeeeek!!

jp: なんでこんなところに
en: What are demons doing in a place like this!!
What a scream.

jp: 落ち着いてる場合じゃないって
en: This is no time to be calm!

jp: まさか、あんたたち悪魔の
en: Don't tell me you're in league with the demons!?

jp: あの、まだ仲間じゃなくて
en: Um, we're not with them, not yet anyway...

jp: 怪しい奴とは思ってたけど
悪魔の仲間だなんて最低！！
en: I knew you were suspicious, but siding with demons is the lowest!!

jp: 同じヒトとして恥ずかしいわ！
en: As a fellow human, I'm ashamed!
She's really laying into you.

jp: 冷静に話し合おうよ、な？
en: Argh, come on. Let's all just calm down and talk this out, okay?

jp: 異端者の言葉なんて聞かないわ！
en: You're friends with black-wings!! I won't listen to a heretic's words!
Say, does the color of someone's wings really matter that much?

jp: 異端者の言葉なんて聞かない！
en: I won't listen to a heretic!

jp: ああ、またも問答無用かよ
en: Ugh, 'enough talk' again.

jp: いつでも逃げられるよう
en: Cain, to be safe, bring out your wings so we can flee at any moment.
Okay.

jp: 嫌な臭いが混じっているとは
en: I thought there was a nasty smell mixed in with the human one...

jp: 手に入れていたとはね
en: Never guessed you'd gotten yourself white wings.
...A-an angel!?

jp: だまされたりはしないわよ！
en: N-no, I won't be fooled! He's in league with the demons too!!

jp: 今ここで悔い改めなさい！！！
en: Heretics!! Repent, here and now!!!
Young man
Bonjour
Cain
